verses.text: E masanil ex kajan ex t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik, b'itananhek t'a Dios t'a tzalajk'olal.
B'itejek sb'inajnakil. B'itananhek t'ay yet' juntzanh b'it manhxo jantakok swach'il.
Alek t'a Dios icha tik: Mamin a tas tza b'o'o, te satub'tak. Ha wal t'a ichanh stelwikan heb' ayoch ajk'olal t'ayach, yujto te niwan a poder.
Masanil heb' anima t'a yol yib'anhk'inal tik syak'em sb'a t'ayach, tzach sb'itan heb', xe chi t'ay.
Kotanhek, ilek wal tas sb'onak Dios. Satub'tak tas sk'ulej yuj ko wach'ilok a onh anima onh tik.
Takinh lu'um ajnak ha' mar yet' ha' niwak ha' yuj, haxo ta' ek'nakkot heb' ko mam kicham. Tzalajokab' ko k'ool t'a Dios.
Ha yet' spoder syak' yajalil t'a masanil tiempo. Aynhejoch sat t'a junjun nación, yik wach' max och heb' syik'chaanh sb'a ajk'olal t'ay.
Ex junjun nación, alek wach' lolonel t'a ko Diosal. Ab'chajokab' he b'itan t'ay t'a wach' lolonelal.
Yujto ha' tz'ak'an ko k 'inal, max onh schalaj telwok.
Ach Dios, tik wal ix il ko pensar. Icha wal sakb'itaj k'een plata, icha wal chi' ix aj onh a sakb'itani.
Ix onh ak'kan t'a te' yaal. Yelxo wal te al ikatz ix ak' ko kuchu'.
Ha heb' komon anima ix ak'lab'ej onh stek'ani. Ix onh ak' ek' t'a skal te' k'ak' yet' t'a yol ha' niwak ha'. Ixlajwi chi' ix onh ik'anb'at b'aj junk'olal tzonh aji.
Ol in och t'a yol a templo yuj wak'an in silab' t'ayach. Ichato wal chi' ol wak'anelk'och in ti' wak'nak t'ayach,
haton tas walnak ayik ay in och t'a ilk'olal.
Ha nok' nok' b'ak'ech ol in nhustz'a t'a altar. Ol wak' nok' wakax, nok' mam chiwa yet' pax nok' ch'ak kalnel in silab'ok t'ayach, haton tik scha a k'ool.
Kotanhek he masanil, mach ex ay yelk'och Dios t'a he sat. Maklejek eyab' t'ayin, ol wal t'ayex jantak swach'k'olal t'ayin.
Ix in k'an skolwal wet'ok, ix walan wach' lolonel t'ay.
K'inalok tato a chukal ix in nib'ej in k'ulej, maj am schalaj yab' Dios Yajal t'a Smasanil tas ix in k'an t'ay.
Palta ix yab'i tas ix in k'an chi' t'ay, ix sk'anab'ajej in lesal.
Alchajokab' wach' lolonel t'a Dios, yujto max spatikejel in lesal, manh puraloklaj ix yak' swach'k'olal t'ayin.
